name: react-audit-pro
description: React audit CLI that analyzes a project's architecture, performance, tests, and TypeScript.

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.release: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run pack:dry
